desc: Costa Rica based 8-string guitarist & world-class e-sports competitor Jodelo delivers is a deep dive into terrorscape soundtracks, horror movies and first person shooter games. Heavy, crushing rock guitar riffs and Latin influenced drumbeats galore.

tracks.desc: Intense, driving, Cuban-rooted, metal instrumental with thick, fuzzed-out processed guitars and a relentless, SALSA influenced, montuno line that delivers a heavy, escalating buildup and high-octane energy for pursuit scenes, intense action sequences, and high-stakes cinematic combat. Regional Mark: Cuba / Salsa. Keywords: action, intense, chase, aggressive, relentless, combat, energetic. Heavy Metal / Fuzz Rock sound-set with an aggressive edge playing over a high-stakes Salsa backbone.

Aggressive, driving, metal instrumental with jagged guitar riffs and heavy-hitting, BOMBA SICÁ influenced percussion. Delivers tension and explosive impact built for supernatural confrontations, tactical combat, and high-intensity horror gameplay. Regional Mark: Puerto Rico / Bomba. Keywords: action, threat, combat, aggressive, supernatural, impact, battle, tension, driving, relentless. Industrial / Nu-Metal sound-set with a sharp, combative flavor playing over traditional Bomba Sicá rhythms.

Fast, aggressive metal instrumental with thrashing processed guitars and a CUMBIA influenced rhythmic drive. Delivers sinister energy and dark tension built for boss battles, high-speed action, and horror-themed gameplay. Regional Mark: Colombia / Cumbia. Keywords: fast, aggressive, thrash, combat, battle, sinister, relentless, action, chaos, horror. Thrash Metal / Industrial sound-set and sinister energy playing over fast Latin breakbeats.

Intense, driving, metal instrumental with aggressive processed guitars and MOZAMBIQUE influenced frantic percussion. Delivers high-stakes tension and chaotic energy built for action sequences, chase scenes, and first-person shooter combat. Regional Mark: Cuba / Mozambique. Keywords: action, driving, frantic, chase, intensity, distressing, combat, aggressive, tension, chaos, unsettling. Dark, heavy mid-tempo instrumental with a MERENGUE influenced outro beat, processed, distorted guitars and a tense rhythmic pulse. Delivers cinematic intrigue and a gritty low-end built for horror suspense, first-person shooters, and ominous urban environments. Regional Mark: Dominican Republic / Merengue. Keywords: underscore, tension, horror, suspense, gritty, industrial, dark, thriller. Heavy Metal / Industrial / Doom sound-set and dark atmosphere playing over slow Merengue rhythms.
